# Contributing

Thank you for helping improve FreeApi.

## Support policy

Only the latest release and the latest LTS release are supported. Please verify issues and changes against one of those versions before opening a report or pull request.

## How to contribute

- Open an issue for bugs, questions, or proposed improvements.
- Keep pull requests focused and small when possible.
- Include clear reproduction steps for bug reports.
- Update documentation when behavior changes.

## Before submitting

- Make sure your changes work on the latest release or the latest LTS release.
- Describe any compatibility impact clearly in your pull request.
- Check that formatting, tests, and linting still pass if the project uses them.
- Follow the code of conduct in all interactions.
